name: Michael Stone
bio: a Representative from Maryland; born at "Equality," near Port Tobacco, Charles County, Md., in 1747; completed preparatory studies; member of the Maryland House of Delegates, 1781-1783; member of the Maryland state ratification convention in 1788; elected as an Anti-Administration candidate to the First Congress (March 4, 1789-March 3, 1791); appointed judge of the first judicial district of Maryland in 1791; died in Charles County, Md., in 1812; interment on his estate, "Equality," near Port Tobacco, Charles County, Md.
